# Release v0.1.0-beta.6

## Overview
This PR merges the latest developments from the develop branch into main, bringing significant new features and improvements.

## Major Features

1. **Interface Serialization**
   - Support for TypeScript interfaces
   - Declarative schema registration
   - Type-safe schema definition

2. **Inline Object Support**
   - Nested object serialization
   - Container support (arrays/maps)
   - Flexible schema definition

3. **Documentation Improvements**
   - Comprehensive examples
   - Updated README
   - Enhanced TSDoc comments

## Technical Highlights
- New `InlineObjectProcessor`
- Enhanced type system
- Improved error handling
- Extended test coverage

## Testing
- All test suites passing (10 tests)
- Coverage maintained
- No regressions found

## Breaking Changes
None. All changes are backward compatible.
